I am 81 years old and I have farmed in Mzimba since I was a boy, so I know beans do not need chemical fertilizer the way maize does. I will put two cartloads of manure on this plot before planting, because the soil stays soft and I do not have to spend cash. I will plant the bean seed I saved from last season — I have not seen any new variety that beats what I already keep. My sons and grandchildren will do the weeding and harvesting, about twenty-five days of family labor in total, and I will not hire anyone because I would rather save that money for the maize plot.
